Cape lies behind UPPER torso, with hem above the hood level, so no cape at ground level. TWO arms TWO legs. Upside-down hood alone covers floor-width58, same scale as standing.

Preserve original red cape with teal inner/cream hem, brown hair, cream dog hood with red-brown ears, teal eyes, paw mitts, dark shorts and red sneakers, same crisp pixelart. All four fully separated, uncut feet/ears/cape. First standing is the ruler for all three, no pose-by-pose resizing.
